NPU.desc: Native Performance + Ultracode — opus+sonnet native, background gpt-5.4.
NPU.notes: Opus 1M main; advisor Opus 1M xhigh; workflows mix Opus xhigh + Sonnet max. Needs key A only (fully native).

NP.desc: Native Performance — opus+sonnet native, background gpt-5.4.
NP.notes: Opus 1M main at max; advisor Opus 1M max; agent teams Opus max + Sonnet max. Needs key A only (fully native).

NB.desc: Native Balance — Sonnet main + Opus advisor (native), background gpt-5.4.
NB.notes: Sonnet 200K main high; advisor Opus 1M xhigh; agent teams Sonnet high + Opus xhigh. Needs key A only (fully native).

HP.desc: Hybrid Performance (no ultracode) — main Sonnet->gpt-5.5, advisor Opus native, background gpt-5.4.
HP.notes: MIXED: opus->native(A), sonnet->gpt55(B55). The opus-tier advisor stays native ONLY if it emits a claude-opus-* name — verify via this router's stderr on one run. Needs keys A + B55 + B54 (background->5.4).

HB.desc: Hybrid Balance (no ultracode) — main Sonnet->gpt-5.4, advisor Opus native, background gpt-5.4.
HB.notes: MIXED: opus->native(A), sonnet->gpt54(B54). Per-role effort differs (main high, advisor xhigh) — set main via settings.json effortLevel, leave CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL unset so subagents keep their own. Needs keys A + B54.

BPU.desc: Backup Performance + Ultracode — opus:gpt-5.5, sonnet:gpt-5.5, bg:gpt-5.4 (main Opus @xhigh).
BPU.notes: Performance backup: opus->gpt55 AND sonnet->gpt55 (both gpt-5.5), background->gpt54. Keep the name claude-opus-* so ultracode enables. No native key used. Distinct from BBU, which routes sonnet->gpt-5.4. Needs keys B55 + B54.

BP.desc: Backup Performance — opus:gpt-5.5, sonnet:gpt-5.5, bg:gpt-5.4 (main Opus @high).
BP.notes: Performance backup: opus->gpt55 AND sonnet->gpt55 (both gpt-5.5), background->gpt54. Same route table as BPU; differs from BPU only by effort (high vs xhigh) + ultracode (BPU has it). Distinct from BB/BBU (sonnet->gpt-5.4). Needs keys B55 + B54.

BB.desc: Backup Balance — opus:gpt-5.5, sonnet:gpt-5.4, bg:gpt-5.4 (main Sonnet @high, advisor Opus->gpt-5.5).
BB.notes: All mapped: opus->gpt55, sonnet->gpt54, background->gpt54. Advisor (opus-tier) lands on gpt55 here. Needs keys B55 + B54.

BBU.desc: Backup Balance + Ultracode — Opus->gpt-5.5 main, Sonnet->gpt-5.4, background gpt-5.4.
BBU.notes: Ultracode only activates at xhigh, so effort is xhigh (run /effort ultracode = xhigh + workflows). Routes sonnet->gpt54 (Balance) — DISTINCT from BPU, which routes sonnet->gpt55 (Performance). Needs keys B55 + B54.
